description: Creates a hosted Revolut payment link for a prepared booking — the RECOMMENDED way for ordinary consumers (no credit line) to pay. Required: `bookingId` (the `preparedBookingId` from `prepare_booking`) and `currency` (3-letter); optional `backUrl` and `successUrl`. REQUIRES A SESSION: pass the token returned by `guest_login` as the `sessionToken` argument. Returns a `checkoutUrl` (valid ~20 minutes), a `checkoutToken`, and a `message`. Share the `checkoutUrl` with the guest to complete payment — the booking is confirmed automatically by webhook once payment succeeds (do not call `confirm_booking`, which is B2B-only).

backUrl.description: Cancel/back redirect URL (optional, defaults to locktrip.com)
